Jamal (CSM): Hey team 	6 kicking off ClearBank onboarding. Quick sync: confirm stakeholders, define success metrics, and lay out 10-day go-live plan. Stand at 9am?
Priya (Success Ops): 9am OK. I'll draft the 10-day checklist.
Anya (Product): From product: target p95 < 180ms for short prompts, embeddings recall >= 0.80 on their seed set, and secure logs enabled.
Liam (Client - ClearBank): We'll use Dedicated later but start hosted. Also want to limit token cost, so interested in quantization.
Ravi (Solutions Eng): Noted. I can propose a quantization + autoscale plan. Who owns infra on ClearBank side?
Liam (Client - ClearBank): Oliver (infra lead) will be point. I'll share.
onboarding-bot: Add to calendar -> /schedule ClearBank onboard 09:00 AM PT (link).
Priya (Success Ops): Draft milestones: Day0 kickoff; Day1 keys & creds; Day2 test harness; Day3-4 load tests; Day5 enablement; Day6 tuning; Day7 sandbox sign-off; Day8 prod prep; Day9 soft launch; Day10 production + monitoring window.
Jamal (CSM): Renewal is ~13 months. Mark initial risk low. If onboarding >30d delayed, escalate.
Anya (Product): Will provide embedding eval set and baseline numbers by EOD.
Ravi (Solutions Eng): I'll run smoke test with this snippet:
```
POST /v1/generate
Body: {"model":"redwood-q4","prompt":"hello","max_tokens":64}
```
Start concurrency at 6.
Liam (Client - ClearBank): Thanks. Oliver will join the Day1 provisioning call. I'll DM his contact.
Priya (Success Ops): Action items: Priya create Asana project; Ravi owns tech notes; Anya provides evals; Jamal stakeholder comms.
Jamal (CSM): Great, see you at 9.
